objective: Develop a graph neural network classifier to discover new altermagnetic materials from crystal structure data

pretrain_data.purpose: Self-supervised pre-training on unlabeled crystal graphs

finetune_data.purpose: Fine-tuning classifier on labeled altermagnet data

candidate_data.purpose: Prediction and evaluation of discovered candidates

methodology.model_architecture: Graph Neural Network with GraphConv layers

expected_outputs.predictions: Probability scores for each candidate material

related_work_insights.altermagnet_definition: Collinear-compensated magnetic phase with crystal-rotation symmetries connecting opposite-spin sublattices
related_work_insights.key_features: d-wave, g-wave, i-wave spin-splitting symmetry in band structure
related_work_insights.spin_space_groups: SSG formalism provides systematic classification of magnetic phases beyond conventional magnetic space groups
